descriptions: The test management plugin will have three built-in TestCases, test plans, and test execution tasks during the initialization phase. Please do not delete them. If the three built-in types are deleted, the test management system isolation configuration will not be enabled

After the test management system isolation configuration is enabled, the type association configuration will not be able to be modified. The test management item association configuration will be associated with the three built-in test management plug-in types by default, and all test workspace type association configurations will be updated to the built-in three types

After the test management system isolation configuration is enabled, the items created by the type associated with the test management will be hidden, and the items will not appear in the workspace view, nor can they be passedIQLsearch query in
